'''Udium''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Wizard Tower}}. They return items the player transferred to the [[Rift Dimension]] through bugs and exploits.

== Trivia ==
* Udium references the [[mcw:Sculk Catalyst|Sculk Catalyst]] in their dialogue, stating that "[they were] playing with [it] in a different world from the future...", probably referencing ''Minecraft'' version 1.19, and how SkyBlock was still centered on version 1.8.9 when the NPC was released.
* Udium also mentions {{NPCSprite|Alatar}}, an NPC found in the Rift, who "disappeared."
